summary.text: Paul Carver is a Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary as a write-in candidate.
He is an at-large member of the Deer Valley Unified School District governing board, a nonpartisan seat he has held since January 1, 2023 and is also seeking in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Carver was elected to the Deer Valley Unified School District at-large seat in the November 8, 2022 general election and took office on January 1, 2023.
His current term ends on January 1, 2027.
Ballotpedia quotes his campaign website as listing students first, parental rights and taxpayer trust as themes of his school board campaign.
